_comment: The checkout package's rights, shipped as a library layer (docs/commerce_PRD.md §4.4). They name only its own type
and only @authenticated: no slot, so no application has to bind anything. Every row is narrowed by OrderAccess (the
buyer's own orders; a seller's Owners, Admins, finance and box-office members the seller's; the platform organization's
every one), so the right alone shows nothing. Orders are written by checkout only: only QueryRead and Read are granted.
The basket and the back-office actions are endpoints (/spark/commerce/checkout/*) with their own checks.
Opt out of all of these with "libraries": { "commerce-checkout": false }.
